purpose: Research queue for the remaining Budget-Friendly Hiking & Trekking catalogue gap. Review-only: not consumed by any seeder or recommendation service.
status: These four candidates remain pending. A later review added Magongawon Falls Forest Trail separately in planner-budget-hiking-2026-11-01.json, with unknown hours, duration and exact current fees retained.
rules: A source review date is not an operator confirmation of current access or rates.
Do not copy a summit coordinate into the road-routing destination point.
Hike duration must include ascent, descent and required registration; an ascent-only time is insufficient.
Include mandatory guide and permit costs when assessing affordability, especially for solo visitors.
Do not assign DOT accreditation, numeric hours, fees or durations without supporting evidence.
Keep the existing audit limits and strict rejection policy. These candidates do not satisfy selected-interest coverage.

candidates.name: Mount Puting Bato — Tayapok trail
candidates.findings: Genuine short hiking candidate near Samal beach attractions. Accounts disagree on weekday access and trail details. The mountain club's September 2025 programme confirms a Sunday hike, not Monday–Thursday availability.

sources.kind: Third-party mirror of a participating mountaineering club
sources.supports: Completed hike; programme listed environmental, trail and summit charges separately, plus transport. Not a current operator tariff.
Reports weekend-only public access. This restriction has not been reconciled with a current site manager.
Tayapok approach and shorter ascent; does not establish present access, full round-trip duration or prices.

needed_before_enablement: Site-manager confirmation of visit-day access and complete fees
Return transport arrangement; a jeep preference is not proof of direct jeep service

candidates.name: Bamboo Peak / Buntod Ta Laya
candidates.location: Barangay Jose Rizal, Santa Cruz, Davao del Sur
candidates.findings: Genuine community hiking destination. A provider reported a completed September 2026 day hike. The detailed December 2025 visitor article actually describes a November 2022 trip: its low registration price is not a verified 2026 total. The same account took approximately six hours for the return hike and charged a solo visitor the entire guide fee.

sources.kind: Third-party mirror of a tour provider
sources.supports: Recent completed day-hike report; published inclusions include guide and permits, but no complete package price.
Historic costs and 06:00–12:00 return-hike chronology. Fees are historical observations, not current catalogue prices.
Trail identity and Sitio Centro approach. A 2021 exploration report does not establish current visitor permissions.

needed_before_enablement: Current solo and group total guide/permit charges
Full hike scheduling with meals, transport and a suitable nearby eligible hotel

candidates.name: Tagaytay Peak of Sinoron
candidates.location: Barangay Sinoron, Santa Cruz, Davao del Sur
candidates.findings: Promising shorter community day-hike candidate. The launch account identifies Sinoron barangay hall as registration point, a 2.8 km outward trail and a compulsory local guide. Current charges, complete hike duration and road-accessible registration geometry remain unverified.

sources.supports: Launched February 17, 2023 with tribal/community management; no unaccompanied visitors. Historical starting rates need reconfirmation.

needed_before_enablement: STWA / barangay confirmation of access and current complete charges
Mapped Sinoron registration point and any onward transfer
Full round-trip duration and permitted start times

candidates.name: Mount Loay — single-peak return hike
candidates.findings: Established hiking destination with recent provider activity. Available accounts disagree on guide rules, registration charges and time required. A race entry price is not ordinary visitor admission. Do not turn a long mountain hike into a short sightseeing slot.

sources.kind: Third-party mirror of a tour provider
sources.supports: 2026 Loay activity reports refer to a five-peak programme, not a priced single-peak walk-in offer.
Fee and ascent-time observations; the page explicitly lacks confirmed open status.
Guided day hike with an early start and afternoon descent; no current tariff or opening window.

needed_before_enablement: Tourism/community confirmation of current single-peak access and fees
Realistic complete hike duration, meals and return transport
